attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"Six of the seven settlements under Tarn Union control","reason":"Briefing gives the Tarn Union 6 settlements, not seven."},{"span":"are located along the river road, leaving only one isolated from trade","reason":"Settlement locations are not in the briefing."},{"span":"three scattered locations deep within the mountain passes","reason":"Raider locations and mountain passes are invented."},{"span":"maintain a defensive perimeter around their four main villages in the central highlands","reason":"The perimeter and the central highlands location are invented."},{"span":"will likely cause delays in transport routes for both the Tribe and the Raiders","reason":"Adds consequences to the forecast that the briefing does not give."},{"span":"marking another attempt to integrate the Outlanders into the Rim economy","reason":"Implies earlier attempts that the briefing does not mention."}],"voice":1,"clarity":3,"tone":2,"overall":1,"comment":"It copies the briefing's section headings into the bulletin, presents faction background as 'Already reported' when this is the first bulletin, and invents locations and a wrong settlement count. The prose is flat and report-like, with none of the dry, wry voice the persona calls for."}
